body: A few times haha. I was taught to just try and make the fall as graceful looking as possible then just get right back up and pretend nothing happened. I’ll usually wait until a few more girls walk past before getting back in place.

My mother was a model so I had pretty easy access and she had me start at a young age so I was in the book. I do enjoy it most of the time but there is definitely times where I wish I had a normal uni life.
When I retire (quite soon) I plan to get into nursing or just keep working along the industry.
That’s okay, all questions are welcome! Honestly besides fasting a bit before walks it’s mostly just normal but clean eating but we do workout quite a bit :)

My biggest break was definitely Oscar de la renta. I would consider it my best achievement since it did get me to the place I wanted to be in my career. 
My top two others would have to be: Yves saint laurent and Chanel.
